note: Washington Parish (FIPS 22117) publishes no queryable zoning district service. Franklinton's zoning map is a static PDF (townoffranklinton.com/zoning-map); the parish GIS portal lists zoning boundaries only generally; Bogalusa's planning page links no zoning map or ordinance; the wpcde-911 map pages are PDFs and a GIS story map with no zoning layer. ArcGIS searches for Washington Parish, Bogalusa and Franklinton found only council/school districts, elections, culverts and a point layer, no zoning polygons.
